Test Scenario: Verify Authenticated Sessions across all 5 Static Pages on US and AU Storefronts
Test Steps:

Step 2: Authenticate on AU Staging with Customer (customer.tester@globewest.com.au).

Step 3: Navigate to each static page: /terms-and-conditions-page, /privacy-policy, /contact-us, /help-centre, /404.
